notes_for_editor: Only the tnlandforms.us list places a tower at Zuta. Two WebSearch rounds and the Wikipedia article found no tower evidence and nothing naming GFC tower 850. The list row gives 22 with no unit; read as feet (the brief's 6.7 m matches). The gfc-850 tag matches the brief's register 'GFC US 850'. Story is short (about 100 words) because one list row is the only tower evidence. Brief status and access 'unknown' are kept. Existence of a tower here needs a check with the Georgia Forestry Commission.
